type Props = { label: string };
export function Label({ label }: Props) {
  // A TSX file should wrap this standalone TypeScript comment
  // while typed props and JSX syntax remain parseable.
  return (
    <span>
      {/*
       * This TSX expression comment should wrap as a standalone
       * comment because the expression braces do not make it
       * inline.
       */}
      {
        /*
         * This TSX expression comment should wrap as a trailing
         * comment because only the expression value appears
         * before it.
         */
        label
      }
      {"abc" + /*inline*/ "123"}
    </span>
  );
}
